purpose: Additional fixed release acceptance queries; not an independent population accuracy estimate.

cases.permitted_conclusion: Larval behavioral nociception; no clinical efficacy claim.

cases.query: Intraoperative nociception monitoring combining EEG PPG and ECG

cases.permitted_conclusion: Neural activity prediction; no pain or SCS outcome validation.

cases.query: Synthetic pain simulation for zero shot multimodal estimation
cases.permitted_conclusion: Reported synthetic-domain result; no established clinical transfer.
